newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $520 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $520 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $520 million in 27 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $370 million in eight sales, with a $300 million Jefferson County, Ala., issue through Raymond James topping the list.
On the competitive side, 19 sales totaling $150 million are on the schedule. A $47 million Cincinnati deal is the largest at 1100 EST.

An additional nine sales totaling $384 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday, depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
